title: The Forest Team
intro: This quiz follows two curious kids and Ranger Mateo as they discover how biotic and abiotic factors work together in an ecosystem.

choices: A place where living and nonliving things interact and depend on one another
A place where only plants grow
A place without water or sunlight
questions.explanation: An ecosystem is a place where living and nonliving things interact and depend on one another.

questions.prompt: What are living or once-living parts of an ecosystem called?
questions.explanation: Living or once-living parts of an ecosystem are called biotic factors.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an abiotic factor?
questions.explanation: Sunlight is an abiotic factor because it is a nonliving part of the ecosystem.

questions.prompt: What do fungi do in an ecosystem?
choices: Break down dead matter and return nutrients to the soil
questions.explanation: Fungi break down dead matter and return nutrients to the soil.

questions.prompt: What happens when the biotic and abiotic teams work together in balance?
choices: The ecosystem stays healthy and strong
questions.explanation: When biotic and abiotic teams work together in balance, the ecosystem stays healthy and strong.
